text: New paper proposes verification harnesses for software agents - The paper argues that agent capability should be measured with task specs, tool registries, and verification artifacts.
Cloud providers expand monitoring tools for AI workloads - New products focus on runtime observability, cost controls, and failure investigation.
Regional internet blackout reported near major data center corridor - Operators report degraded access and possible routing instability.
Regional internet access restored near major data center corridor - Follow-up report says the outage has cleared and monitoring is normal.
